results.detail: 71 distinct words checked; code written as BAD in all 2 mentions
No black frames, no frozen stretches over 1.5 s. Contact sheet (1 frame/s) reviewed by eye: contact-sheet.png
Integrated -14.2 LUFS, true peak -1.1 dBTP, no clipping, no silence gaps. All sound is original synthesis (no game rips, no copyrighted music). No voiceover in this cut.
1080x1920 h264 60 fps, aac 48000 Hz, 16.3s. Fits TikTok, Reels, Shorts, X, Facebook, Threads. Every on-screen text box sampled 4x/s stays out of the top bar, bottom caption area and button column.
#EpicPartner is the first hashtag in caption line 1 and on screen in every sampled frame from 0.0s. No discount, giveaway, endorsement or filler-CTA wording.

results.check: 7. Would a fan stop scrolling? Made by a person?
results.detail: Reviewer: Claude (owner still decides at check 8). Frame 1 already shows the payoff: the Pac-Man-shaped island and the headline, no logo intro. Something changes every 1-2 s (pin drop, pull-out, pan, cards, overview), the card beat holds about 3 s so it can be read. Every visual is either the official map or drawn for this video; nothing is a stock template. Readable on mute. The last frame matches the first, so it loops.

items.note: Weakest moment: 3.4-4.3 s, the headline changes while the camera is still travelling. Acceptable, but a voiceover line here would carry it.
No voice yet. A real voice reading the two headlines would lift retention; record it or hire a voice actor. Text-to-speech is not allowed by the brief.
Music is an original synthesized bed. On TikTok/Reels, swap it for a licensed library sound in the app if you want trend reach.
